name: figma-deep-dive
description: Claude Code plugin for reading, tidying and building Figma screens. The figma-deep-dive agent extracts distilled, structured specs from Figma node IDs while keeping main-context token usage low; /figma-screens audits and applies a screen naming convention (confirm-gated) and writes a 'Screens to build' section into a PRD; the figma-screens-from-source skill rebuilds a screen recording, code or HTML, screenshots, a written spec or an old-format Figma page as design-system-native screens, using your own library or none. Self-installing: run /figma-setup.
